reading.zh: 产业层承载企业生命周期：居民通过 found 行动自办企业（资本自其账户转入，货币守恒），企业成立后由 stage2 招募工人并放发创业贷款；经营失败则破产消亡。企业数不是常数——市场容量把**存活数**锁在上限（实测三种子恒为 5/5/5），真实的涌现信号在**累计创办数**与**破产数**上（实测 87/68/81 与 82/63/76）。
reading.en: The industry layer carries the business lifecycle: agents found firms via the found action (capital moves from their account, conserving money), stage2 then recruits workers and issues start-up credit, and failed firms go bankrupt. Firm count is not a constant - market capacity pins the LIVE count at its ceiling (measured 5/5/5 across seeds), so the real emergence signal is in cumulative foundings and bankruptcies (measured 87/68/81 and 82/63/76).
